title: Beyond the Black Box: A Diagnosis-Driven Agent for Interpretable MIP Solver Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30670v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tuning a mixed-integer programming (MIP) solver is an instance-specific problem, where a poor configuration can increase solving time by orders of magnitude.   Existing Bayesian optimization tuners treat solver tuning as a black-box optimization problem: each evaluation returns a single score, allowing the tuner to learn which configuration is faster, but not why.   Inspired by the use of profilers in GPU-kernel optimization, we introduce APEC (Agent for Per-instance Explainable Configuration), a log-grounded tuning agent for MIP solvers.   APEC has three layers: a deterministic layer that profiles each log, an interpretation layer that guides hypothesis-driven diagnosis, and a system layer that controls evaluation, enabling more reliable and interpretable solver tuning. translated_title: 超越黑箱：面向可解释混合整数规划（MIP）求解器调优的诊断驱动智能体
translated_abstract: 调优混合整数规划（MIP）求解器是一个与具体求解实例相关的问题，糟糕的配置可能使求解时间增加数个数量级。现有的贝叶斯优化调优器将求解器调优视为黑箱优化问题：每次评估仅返回一个单一分数，这使得调优器只能学到哪个配置更快，却无法得知原因。受GPU内核优化中性能分析器（profiler）使用方式的启发，我们提出了APEC（Agent for Per-instance Explainable Configuration，面向单实例可解释配置的智能体），一个基于日志的MIP求解器调优智能体。APEC包含三层结构：对每份日志进行性能剖析的确定性层、引导基于假设的诊断的解释层，以及控制评估过程的系统层，从而实现更可靠、更可解释的求解器调优。在完整的MIPLIB 2017基准测试集上，APEC相比默认配置取得了1.58倍的性能提升，同时参数更改次数比基线方法减少超过38%……
tldr: 提出APEC，一个基于日志的三层诊断驱动智能体，通过假设驱动的可解释诊断实现针对具体实例的MIP求解器参数调优，在MIPLIB 2017上相比默认配置提速1.58倍且参数更改减少超过38%。
en_tdlr: APEC, a log-grounded three-layer agent with hypothesis-driven diagnosis, enables interpretable per-instance tuning of MIP solvers, achieving 1.58X speedup over the default configuration with over 38% fewer parameter changes on MIPLIB 2017.
